unsupported.statusLine: OpenCode offers plugins no status line surface; run jevris status.
unsupported.subagents: Jevris makes no permission decision in a subagent, so OpenCode's rules for the subagent's agent, plus the parent's denies, govern it, and no OpenCode stop is held. A child session names its parent only on session.created; the plugin remembers it and records the child's events under the parent session.

compatibility.basis: Not yet checked against OpenCode's release notes. Same-minor is the default, and a new minor is re-checked in the background. A patch that changes the plugin API shows up as a malformed live event, which demotes that feature and re-checks it.
